name: @lexq/cli
stderr:
Usage: lexq [options] [command]

Command-line interface for the LexQ Decision Operations Platform. Manage
policies, run Impact Simulation, and deploy from your terminal.

Options:
  -V, --version                output the version number
  --format <format>            Output format: json or table (default: "json")
  --api-key <key>              Override stored API key
  --base-url <url>             Override API base URL — must include the API
                               prefix, e.g.
                               http://localhost:8080/api/v1/partners
  --dry-run                    Preview the HTTP request without executing
  --verbose                    Show request/response details
  --no-color                   Disable colored output
  -h, --help                   display help for command

Commands:
  auth                         Manage authentication
  status                       Check API connectivity and authentication
  groups                       Manage policy groups
  versions                     Manage policy versions
  rules                        Manage policy rules
  facts                        Manage fact definitions (schema)
  domain-templates             Browse and apply domain templates
  deploy                       Deployment lifecycle and history
  analytics                    Dry run, simulation, and requirements
  profile [options] <groupId>  Per-rule latency profile with relative slow-rule
                               flags
  history                      Execution history
  replay                       Decision Replay
  provenance                   Decision Provenance
  logs                         Failure logs
  webhook-subscriptions        Manage platform event webhook subscriptions
  serve [options]              Start LexQ as a server for AI agent integrations
  help [command]               display help for command
